terminus.result: Quality scoring must follow genre identification. A field note can be excellent ore through chronology, actors and conflicting observations; a catalog can be excellent ore as an index despite lacking argument. One generic quality score would misclassify both.
terminus.methodChange: Track reusable value by dimensions such as argument, evidence/data, observation, index/navigation and originality/problem formation. Authorship is provenance, not a quality proxy.
